user_saw: Pressing Play on a browser-compatible QuickTime MOV in chat showed 'Preparing playback…' for several seconds while the whole clip was re-encoded.
summary: Playback preparation now remuxes browser-compatible MOV streams into MP4 without re-encoding, waits up to 500 ms for that result on the first check, reuses the in-flight job, falls back to a full encode on failure, and the player shows preparation only once the server reports pending.
reasoning: The prior path always did a full ffmpeg encode for MOV, as designed; the fix adds a faster lossless remux path and adjusts the pending indicator. Playback worked before and was never faster, so this is a performance improvement rather than a regression or broken feature.
